submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The Formula-Feeding Mama (Left Out)"
finding.problem: "All the advice is for breastfeeding. I bottle-feed and I feel like a failure AND I have no plan for ME. I don't need 500 extra calories — I need to heal."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 27-yr-old mum who couldn't breastfeed (supply/medical); every guide is "for breastfeeding mums"; she still needs recovery nutrition but feels guilty and ignored.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Bottle or Breast, You Still Need to Heal: Postpartum Nutrition for Formula Mums." (underserved, low competition)". Verdict: PASSES (23/25)..
